title: Saturated models: realizing types and extending elementary maps

based_on.title: Lecture Notes: An Introduction to Model Theory
based_on.pages: 23 (Definition 4.2.2 and the countable specialization of Lemma 4.2.3; PDF revised 2021-07-13)

summary: Realize finite-parameter types and extend finite elementary matches to embeddings and countable isomorphisms.
abstract: A consistent type may be realized in an elementary extension while having no solution in the structure where its parameters came from. An omega-saturated structure already contains a solution whenever only finitely many parameters are used. We show how this supplies one new value for a finite elementary map without changing its old values. Given an omega-saturated target with the same first-order theory, repeating the construction embeds any countable source structure into that target. When both structures are countable and saturated, requests from both sides produce an isomorphism extending any prescribed finite elementary match. The same method turns equality of finite-tuple types into an automorphism. We also prove that one-variable saturation realizes all finite tuple types, that naming finitely many points preserves saturation, and that the standard natural numbers fail it.
